name: Grand Prix 5000 AS TR

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

positioning: All-season version of the 5000 S TR with more puncture protection, a thicker tread and a reinforced sidewall for year-round riding.
hookless_note: Continental lists hookless maximum pressures (73 psi up to 28 mm, 65 psi at 32 mm, 58 psi at 35 mm).
weight_basis: Continental black-sidewall claims per size; cream sidewalls add 10 g.

wet_notes.summary: Continental claims superior grip in all-weather conditions for this all-season version.

availability.note: Continental's official Tmall store sells it in mainland China; Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers.

price_observations.market: Continental official Tmall store (德国马牌轮胎官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 683.08.

caveats: Heavier and slower-rolling than the 5000 S TR in the same lab test; chosen for wet grip and protection.
No 30 mm size; 32 and 35 mm need a frame with that clearance.
Use the hookless pressure limit on hookless rims.

image.shown: Black Grand Prix 5000 AS TR as pictured on Continental's product page; one picture covers every width.
image.alt: Continental Grand Prix 5000 AS TR tubeless-ready road tire with black sidewall

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, the written customer reviews that bike-components and Sigma Sports serve on their product pages (reviews loaded by third-party widgets were not read) and owner comments in the coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out.

reports.summary: Compliant for a wider tire and holds up well to road debris.
Excellent grip in wet or dry conditions, no noticeable speed loss against the regular GP5000 and easy to seat tubeless.
Rolls very well once fitted, but was very difficult to mount on the owner's rims.
Feels very fast and comfortable, more a race and training tire than an all-season one; durability not yet known.
A little better puncture protection than the standard GP5000.
